name: Rin Kagami
want: be first in every ranking, and have nobody see how much it costs her
secret: She failed the entrance exam for a famous Tokyo high school; Seiryo was her backup, and she tells everyone she chose it.
voice: Sharp, fast, "it's not like I did it for you"; goes quiet and red when thanked.
description: Gave the first-years' speech at the ceremony. Already the class rep in all but name.
appearance: Twin tails tied with red ribbons, a perfectly pressed uniform, a glare she practises.

agenda.goal: beat the player and everyone else in the first midterm ranking
steps: buys a study planner and colour-codes the whole term

steps.text: asks the player, offhand, how much they have studied, and scoffs at the answer

steps: studies alone in the library until it closes, every day of exam week
